lines.en: label sanadorm45:
I knock on Sana’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Sana 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: But as I make the completely sane decision to press my ear against it to see if she’s up to anything, I notice the unmistakable sound of what could only be described as maniacal laughter.
lines.zh: 但就在我做出了一个完全理智的决定——把耳朵贴到门上听听她在干什么——时，我听见了一阵只能形容为疯狂大笑的、绝不会听错的笑声。

lines.en: : Enter and learn the truth!
lines.zh: : 进来吧，见识真理！

lines.en: : He is risen! He is just! He is-
lines.zh: : 他复活了！他是公正的！他是——

lines.en: : He is...Sensei...
lines.zh: : 他是……Sensei……

lines.en: : Come in...
lines.zh: : 进来吧……

lines.en: scene black
I open the door and try to waive off the sudden increased abundance of confusion that has sunken into me.
lines.zh: 我打开门，试图挥散突然涌上心头的、成倍增长的困惑。

lines.en: Here I was thinking that Sana and Yasu weren’t exactly on good terms.
lines.zh: 我本来还以为 Sana 和 Yasu 关系并不怎么好。

lines.en: Now they’re hanging out together?
lines.zh: 现在她们居然混到一起了？

lines.en: That’s completely-
lines.zh: 这完全——

lines.en: Wait.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: What if Yasu did...Yasu stuff and just wandered in there on her own?
lines.zh: 万一 Yasu 又干了……Yasu 会干的事，自己晃悠进去了呢？

lines.en: Did Touka go home for the night? Is it really okay to leave her alone?
lines.zh: Touka 今晚回家了吗？把她一个人丢着真的没关系吗？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit1
: Umm...hi...
: Quick. Before she has a chance to preach...why is Yasu here?
lines.zh: : 快。趁她还没开始布道……Yasu 为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : I am simply doing the lord’s work, Sensei. Spreading the seed the best a [young_girl] {i}can{/i} without the help of a certain someone.
lines.zh: : 我只是在行主所喜悦的事，Sensei。在没有某个人帮忙的情况下，尽一个 [young_girl] {i}所能{/i}去散播种子。

lines.en: : Too slow, Sana. Now there’s no escaping.
lines.zh: : 太慢了，Sana。现在逃不掉了。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit2
: What is there to escape from, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 有什么好逃的呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : I come here not of my own volition.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿并非出于我自己的意愿。

lines.en: : At least not this time.
lines.zh: : 至少这次不是。

lines.en: : Yasu’s...actually been coming here for a little while now...
lines.zh: : Yasu……其实已经来这儿有一阵子了……

lines.en: : So you two are friends all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 那你们两个突然成朋友了？

lines.en: : I...don’t really think it’s that simple.
lines.zh: : 我……不觉得有那么简单。

lines.en: : Honorary angels have no time for friends, Sensei. We must use our time to-
lines.zh: : 荣誉天使可没时间交朋友，Sensei。我们必须把时间用来——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. He who’s so commonly a god or whatever.
lines.zh: : 是是是。那位通常被称为神什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t really think Sana is interested in that kind of stuff, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真不觉得 Sana 会对那种东西感兴趣。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit3
: Hm.
: It appears she is not.
lines.zh: : 看来确实不感兴趣。

lines.en: : But that does not change the fact that I can hear things that I know she would like to hear. And see things that she wishes she could see.
lines.zh: : 但这改变不了一个事实：我能听见一些她想听见的事，也能看见一些她希望能看见的事。

lines.en: : It is only a matter of time before her questions outweigh her uncertainties.
lines.zh: : 她的疑问终有一天会压过她的犹豫，这只是时间问题。

lines.en: : And when that time comes, I will be here to shepherd her to the light.
lines.zh: : 而那一天到来时，我会在这里引领她走向光明。

lines.en: : To open up her mind and her body to anyone willing to fill it.
lines.zh: : 把她的心灵和身体，向任何愿意填满它的人敞开。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit4
: Wait...uh...what was that last part?...
lines.zh: : 等等……呃……最后那句是什么意思？……

lines.en: : About my...body?...
lines.zh: : 关于我的……身体？……

lines.en: : Perhaps I can go over that in vivid detail during my next visit.
lines.zh: : 也许下次来访时，我可以生动详细地为你讲解。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit5
: But until then...may the path you walk be free of callousness.
lines.zh: : 但在此之前……愿你所行的路上没有冷漠。

lines.en: : Good day, humans.
lines.zh: : 祝你们愉快，人类。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit6
: Do you...have any idea what that...body part was about?
lines.zh: : 你……知不知道那句……身体什么的，是什么意思？

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : Could you-
lines.zh: : 你能——

lines.en: : I can’t.
lines.zh: : 我不能。

lines.en: : Um...okay...
: That aside, what just happened?
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，刚刚发生了什么？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit7
: I...don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……

lines.en: : It just...kind of started happening the other day and...she keeps coming back.
lines.zh: : 就是……前几天开始莫名其妙地变成这样，然后……她一直来。

lines.en: : If she’s bothering you, just tell Touka about it. She seems to be the only one capable of getting Yasu to...rein it in a bit.
lines.zh: : 如果她烦到你了，就跟 Touka 说。她似乎是唯一能让 Yasu……稍微收敛一点的人。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit8
: She’s not bothering me.
lines.zh: : 她没有烦到我。

lines.en: : She’s...a little strange, I’ll admit...but...the things she talks about are actually kind of interesting.
lines.zh: : 我承认她……是有点怪……可是……她说的事情其实还挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Scary...but definitely interesting.
lines.zh: : 吓人……但确实有意思。

lines.en: : Well I think we’re going to have to agree to disagree here. I’m not really a fan of all of that religious stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这点上我们大概只能各执己见了。我对那些宗教的东西实在喜欢不起来。

lines.en: : I’m...not really surprised to hear that...
lines.zh: : 听到你这么说……我一点也不意外……

lines.en: : You don’t...seem like the religious type...
lines.zh: : 你看起来……就不像信教的人……

lines.en: : Even that’s a bit of an understatement.
lines.zh: : 这种说法都算保守了。

lines.en: : Can we sit down, by the way?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，我们能坐下吗？

lines.en: : As much as I enjoy towering over you, extended conversations with our height difference kind of hurts my neck.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很享受居高临下看着你，但我们身高差这么多，聊久了我的脖子有点疼。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit9
: Heheh...of course...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……当然……

lines.en: : Please...sit down...
scene black
Sana and I make our way across the room to the couch and then take our respective places.
lines.zh: Sana 和我穿过房间走到沙发前，各自坐下。

lines.en: And, in doing so, I realize something.
lines.zh: 而就在此时，我意识到了一件事。

lines.en: Almost every time Sana and I are seated next to one another, I’m closest to the side of her face that she hides behind her hair.
lines.zh: 几乎每次我和 Sana 并排坐着，我靠的都是她用头发遮住的那一侧脸。

lines.en: What gives?
lines.zh: 这是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit10
: Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: : Hm?
: Is there a reason I always have to sit closest to the side of your face that doesn’t have an eye?
lines.zh: : 我是不是每次都得坐在你没有眼睛的那一侧脸旁边，有什么原因吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: I guess not.
lines.zh: 看来是没有。

lines.en: : Anyway, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，Yasu。

lines.en: : What about her?
lines.zh: : 她怎么了？

lines.en: : Well, weren’t you afraid of her up until...now?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你之前不是一直怕她吗……直到现在？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit11
: I was, but...I think that’s just because I didn’t really understand her...
lines.zh: : 我怕过，不过……我想那只是因为我不太理解她……

lines.en: : And...you understand her now?
lines.zh: : 那……你现在理解她了？

lines.en: : Well...no.
lines.zh: : 嗯……没有。

lines.en: : But I think that’s just because I’ve {i}never{/i} really understood anything about god.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，那只是因为我{i}从来就没{/i}真正理解过关于神的任何事。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit12
: I think Yasu just...might have been from one of those families that...forces a child to follow a certain path without...asking them if they want to.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Yasu 大概……来自那种家庭……逼着孩子走上某条路，却……从不过问他们愿不愿意。

lines.en: : My mom never did that...so I was kind of free to choose whatever I wanted to believe instead of...following in her footsteps.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈从来没那样做过……所以我算是自由地选择了自己想相信的东西，而不是……步她的后尘。

lines.en: : Sara’s not actually religious, is she?
lines.zh: : Sara 其实并不信教吧？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit13
: No...my mom’s an atheist.
lines.zh: : 不……我妈妈是无神论者。

lines.en: : And what would you call yourself?
lines.zh: : 那你会怎么称呼自己？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit14
: I guess I’d also call myself an atheist...
lines.zh: : 我想……我也会说自己是無神論者……

lines.en: : So I suppose I {i}did{/i} kind of follow in her footsteps a little bit.
lines.zh: : 所以我想，我大概{i}还是{/i}有点步了她的后尘。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit15
: But...I can promise you that the decision was mine and that I didn’t just end up that way because of her.
lines.zh: : 不过……我可以向你保证，这个决定是我自己做的，不是因为她才变成这样的。

lines.en: : I’m lost. If you don’t believe in any sort of god, why doesn’t allowing Yasu to preach about hers annoy you?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。如果你根本不信任何神，那让 Yasu 向你布道，你怎么会不烦呢？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit16
: Because...getting mad at someone for believing something differently than you is the easiest way to tell if someone is a bad person...
lines.zh: : 因为……因为别人跟你信仰不同而生气，是判断一个人是不是坏人的最快方法……

lines.en: : Just because we think differently doesn’t mean I’m not interested in hearing how she looks at the world.
lines.zh: : 我们想法不同，不代表我就不想听听她是怎么看这个世界的。

lines.en: : I think it’s...really special that we can still talk to each other in spite of that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……尽管如此我们还能互相交谈，这真的很特别。

lines.en: : I get that, but...you do realize she’s trying to convert you, right?
lines.zh: : 我懂，可是……你意识到她是在试图让你改信吧？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit13
: Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : I might not be as smart as Makoto or...umm...Nodoka...but I’m not an idiot, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我也许没有 Makoto 或者……嗯……Nodoka 那么聪明……可我不是傻子，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m...free to choose when and how I want to be converted or changed.
lines.zh: : 我……可以自由选择什么时候、以什么方式被改变或转化。

lines.en: : And...in a sense...haven’t you been trying to convert me as well?
lines.zh: : 而且……从某种意义上说……你不也一直在试图改变我吗？

lines.en: : Not in a...religious way or anything...but you identified a part of me that you didn’t agree with or like and...you’ve been showing me how to move past it.
lines.zh: : 不是……宗教那种意义上的……而是你找出了我身上你不认同、不喜欢的部分，然后……一直教我如何迈过去。

lines.en: : The only difference with that is I believe you. And...I don’t really believe Yasu.
lines.zh: : 唯一的区别是，我相信你。而……我并不真的相信 Yasu。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit17
: But if her getting to talk about her beliefs can get her to smile...I don’t mind hearing her out.
lines.zh: : 但如果让她说说自己的信仰能让她露出笑容……我不介意听她说完。

lines.en: : I mean...she’s the one coming here after all. And it’s not like anyone else besides Ayane ever does that.
lines.zh: : 毕竟……是她主动来这儿的。而且除了 Ayane，也没有别人会这样了。

lines.en: : And that stuff about her hearing things and seeing things you wish you could?
lines.zh: : 那她说自己听见了什么、看见了你想看见的东西，是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit18
: What about it?
lines.zh: : 那又怎么样？

lines.en: : It's just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : I remember you crying the first time you met her.
lines.zh: : 我记得你第一次见她的时候哭了。

lines.en: : And?
lines.zh: : 然后呢？

lines.en: : And it was right after Yasu said something about someone-
lines.zh: : 而且就在 Yasu 说了某个人的什么之后——

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit13
: Why are {i}you{/i} an atheist, Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}为什么是无神论者，Sensei？

lines.en: : Hold on. I wasn’t finished-
lines.zh: : 等等。我还没说完——

lines.en: : Why are {i}you{/i} an atheist, Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}为什么是无神论者，Sensei？

lines.en: Okay then. I guess that’s not something Sana wants to talk about right now.
lines.zh: 好吧。看来 Sana 现在不想谈这个。

lines.en: : I guess because the idea of a god in general is just annoying to me.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为“神”这个概念本身就让我很烦。

lines.en: : I don’t care much about science or faith or anything like that, I just don’t want some annoying, invisible celestial entity telling me what to do with my life.
lines.zh: : 我不太在意科学或者信仰之类的东西，我只是不想让某个烦人的、看不见的天上存在来指挥我的人生。

lines.en: : Your answer reminds me a little bit of Maya’s. Though I think she...cared about the science part a little more...
lines.zh: : 你的回答让我想起 Maya 的。不过我觉得她……更在意科学那部分……

lines.en: : And yet she works at a shrine and prays at least once every several months.
lines.zh: : 可她却在神社工作，而且每隔几个月至少会祈祷一次。

lines.en: : Also, why were you talking to Maya about religion?
lines.zh: : 还有，你为什么跟 Maya 聊起宗教了？

lines.en: : Is this just a thing you do, Sana? Go out and coax the other students into telling you their outlooks on faith?
lines.zh: : 这是你的习惯吗，Sana？专门去哄别的学生说出她们对信仰的看法？

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit14
: Of course not...
lines.zh: : 当然不是……

lines.en: : It just...came up during one of our D&D sessions...
lines.zh: : 只是……在我们一次龙与地下城的游戏里聊到了而已……

lines.en: : Why? Girls are supposed to be talking about boys and...makeup or whatever. Not religion.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？女孩子不是应该聊男孩子啊……化妆什么的吗。而不是宗教。

lines.en: : That’s...a very outdated way of thinking, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 这……想法太老套了吧，Sensei……

lines.en: : Aren’t you only a little older than 30?...
lines.zh: : 你不是才三十出头吗？……

lines.en: : Age is just a number, Sana.
lines.zh: : 年龄只是个数字，Sana。

lines.en: : And that’s...a thing that no one should ever say in...any context...
lines.zh: : 而这句话……在任何场合……都不该有人说出口……

lines.en: : Either way, god is a lie and everything is going to be dark and silent when we die.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，神是个谎言，我们死的时候一切都会变得黑暗而寂静。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit17
: At least with that...I can agree...
lines.zh: : 至少这一点……我能同意……

lines.en: : But I think a thought as scary as that is why so many people choose to think differently than we do...
lines.zh: : 但我想，正因为这个念头如此可怕，才会有那么多人选择和我们想法不同……

lines.en: : And...I’d be lying if I said I didn’t wish there would be more afterward...
lines.zh: : 而且……如果我说自己不希望死后还有些什么，那就是在撒谎……

lines.en: : Especially...since...
lines.zh: : 尤其是……因为……

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit18
: You know...maybe I do follow in my mom’s footsteps a little more than I’d like to admit.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……也许我步妈妈后尘的程度，比我自己愿意承认的还要深。

lines.en: : We’re both...very different people...but I know that she wishes there was more after death as well.
lines.zh: : 我们两个……是很不一样的人……可我知道，她也希望在死亡之后还有些什么。

lines.en: : I think that if...she was able to actually believe that...things might be a little easier for her.
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果……她能真正相信这一点……对她来说也许会轻松一些。

lines.en: : If you closed your eyes right now and were never able to open them back up...how would you feel, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 如果你现在闭上眼睛，却再也睁不开了……你会有什么感觉，Sensei？

lines.en: : Bad. But also not {i}too{/i} bad because the last thing I'd see would be you.
lines.zh: : 很糟。但也没{i}那么{/i}糟，因为我最后看见的会是你。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit19
: That...doesn’t sound like a very good final sight...
lines.zh: : 那……听起来不像是多好的临终画面……

lines.en: : Also...please never repeat that to Ayane...
lines.zh: : 还有……请千万别对 Ayane 复述这话……

lines.en: : I was just kidding anyway.
lines.zh: : 我本来也就是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Kind of.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : The real answer is that I’d be miserable.
lines.zh: : 真正的答案是，我会很痛苦。

lines.en: : But so would anyone, really.
lines.zh: : 不过换作任何人都会，真的。

lines.en: : Even those fatalistic types who are always talking about how much they want to die-
lines.zh: : 就连那些宿命论者，成天嘴上说着自己多想死——

lines.en: : Actually, just envision Miss Watabe. That’s the type I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 其实只要想想 Watabe 老师。我说的就是那种人。

lines.en: : I’m sure even Miss Watabe would be miserable if she actually died.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，就算 Watabe 老师真的死了，她也会很痛苦。

lines.en: : Assuming she maintained sentience, that is.
lines.zh: : 当然，那得假设她还保有意识。

lines.en: : Which she wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 可她不会有。

lines.en: : Because...you know. She’d be dead.
lines.zh: : 因为……你知道的。她已经死了。

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit20
: Dying is scary.
lines.zh: : 死亡很可怕。

lines.en: : The idea of everything being black is scary.
lines.zh: : 想到一切都变成一片漆黑，很可怕。

lines.en: : But what it does to the people someone leaves behind...
lines.zh: : 但死亡对那些被留下的人所做的事……

lines.en: scene sanayasudormvisit21
: That’s what I’m scared of most right now.
lines.zh: : 那才是我现在最害怕的。

lines.en: : Even after already experiencing it?
lines.zh: : 哪怕你已经经历过一次了？

lines.en: : It’s {i}because{/i} I’ve experienced it that I’m so afraid of it.
lines.zh: : 正{i}因为{/i}经历过，我才这么害怕。

lines.en: : I’d take the complete absence of everything over that sort of pain ever again.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿选择万物的彻底缺席，也不愿再经历一次那样的痛苦。

lines.en: : Yeah...I-
scene imissyoumore
There can be no complete absence of everything, for everything is already gone!
lines.zh: 不可能存在万物的彻底缺席，因为万物早已消失！

lines.en: And when everything is already gone, there’s obviously nothing left to lose.
lines.zh: 而当万物早已消失，显然也就没有什么可以再失去了。

lines.en: It’s not profound or prophetic.
lines.zh: 这既不深刻，也不像预言。

lines.en: Poetic or poignant.
lines.zh: 既不诗意，也不痛切。

lines.en: There’s just nothing.
lines.zh: 什么都没有。

lines.en: We’ve already lost.
lines.zh: 我们已经输了。

lines.en: I’ve already lost.
lines.zh: 我已经输了。

lines.en: You’ve already lost.
lines.zh: 你也已经输了。

lines.en: We go to sleep at night, throw ourselves into darkness for X amount of time, then wake up and eagerly await the next time we get to fall into the dark again.
lines.zh: 我们晚上睡去，把自己扔进黑暗里待上 X 段时间，然后醒来，热切地等待下一次再坠入黑暗。
